column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the DAST gate in CI. Any warning not listed here fails the build.
# Format: <alert id> <TAB> IGNORE <TAB> (reason)   or   <alert id> <TAB> OUTOFSCOPE <TAB> <url regex>
# False positive: Razor HTML-encodes all output, and the reflected value is the user's own form input.
# Informational only: it is the antiforgery cookie.
# Only the OIDC correlation/nonce cookies. They must be sent on the cross-site form_post from Keycloak.
# "/" redirects anonymous users to Keycloak's login page. ZAP follows the redirect and reports
# Keycloak's own headers and scripts under "/". Keycloak is a separate product, not scanned here.
